profile.headline: Content Marketing and Triage at Apple

positions.title: Apple Vision Pro App Marketing  & Bug Triage
positions.description:
- Create and curate the Apple Vision Pro Companion editorial feed.
- Use internal tooling to produce content story cards, while programming and QC’ing partner-team content.
- Quality-control content across the feed and, when issues surface, file, track, and drive them to resolution, root causing to the direct fix and routing each to the right owner.
- Triage for the Apple Vision Pro App, and built internal tooling.

positions.title: Technical Expert
positions.description:
- Led team support and process improvement initiatives, including post repair documentation standards, conversion tracking best practices, weekly recognition newsletters, and quality and cleanliness standards for tools and workspace,  while supporting peer development.
- Educate customers on Apple products and features, translating complex technical concepts into clear, accessible guidance and personalized solutions.
- Maintain high bar for accuracy. Staying current on Apple product knowledge, store goals, and Knowledge Base articles so guidance is precise, consistent, and trusted.
- Diagnosed and resolved complex hardware and software issues using structured troubleshooting and Apple diagnostic tools, sustaining strong Same Unit Repair (SUR) performance and customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
- Proficient in quickly evaluating customers' support requirements upon their arrival, delivering timely solutions, or directing them to relevant team members when necessary.
- Adaptable and open to regularly transitioning across different technical specialties and skill sets.
- Excel in a setting characterized by evolving products, by demonstrating product knowledge and expertise.

positions.title: IT assistant and Web Developer
positions.description:
- Building upon WordPress to update website with high quality standards.
- Communicate with Attorneys and their teams to draft and post accurate stories about
major settlements to boost clientele.
-  Boost marketing on social media platforms, reach targeted clients and keep up with
standard. Manage, track, and analyze the stream of marketing to be as productive and
profitable as possible.

positions.title: Pre-litigation
positions.description:
- Work with software applications for workplace tasks such as, client intake, access, and store documents, manage and drop client cases, keep log of activity, etc. 
- Communicate efficiently via phone, fax, telecommunications systems, and email.
- Build legal documents for attorney review and case preparation.

positions.title: Guest Operations Crew Member
positions.description:
- Communicated engaging and exciting storytelling about NASA programs to international guests, space exploration, and organizational history to diverse audiences, strengthening guest understanding and engagement.
- Built and maintained deep knowledge of NASA programs and exhibit content, serving as a go-to resource for guest questions and delivering accurate, confident answers on the spot.

organizations.name: DNA Women@Apple
organizations.description: Collaborate across teams to drive initiatives that promote inclusion, professional development, and representation within Apple.

organizations.name: Koding with Klossy
organizations.description: Mentored young women and gender-expansive youth in coding their first mobile app as a representative of Apple.
